findings_summary: The two publications each received an authorized same-minute task-global CLAIM on Issue #240. Because non-cohort ownership is single-valued, those CLAIMs cannot both remain execution authority. Selecting one publication and discarding the other would unnecessarily kill active research. The canonical lane-scoped execution contract already supports different retained publications under one task, so the fail-closed repair is: select TP2-DE338F269CA11E9BC01B only as compatibility operational head, retain TP2-D78DBA0243911E0363FA, open a two-lane cohort, and require fresh lane-scoped CLAIMs. The operational choice follows earlier publication/comment ordering only and grants no mathematical priority.
